name: bluetooth
title: Bluetooth
description: Paired devices: connect, disconnect, see the battery.
author: pal

store.tagline: Connect and disconnect paired devices, battery in view
features: Every paired device, connected ones first, with a glyph for its kind (headphones, speaker, keyboard, mouse, controller, phone, watch, computer)
The battery on the right when the OS reports it; AirPods show `L 80% · R 75% · Case 90%`
`enter` connects or disconnects, on the state read back from the OS at that moment; Disconnect asks first
Nothing to install: IOBluetooth on macOS, `bluetoothctl` on Linux
Live: the connected state is read again on every show

screenshots.caption: Paired devices, the connected ones first with their battery
Connect a device that is not, or copy its address

actions.title: Connect / Disconnect
actions.description: Toggles the connection; Disconnect asks first; the HUD says which happened.

bluetooth.description: Every paired device, the connected ones first, with battery when the OS reports it.
